subject: BluePeak portal enrollment + MSA / Order Form — gating items and next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: procurement@bluepeakhealth.com, j.silva@bluepeakhealth.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Portal enrollment + initial redline (MSA + Order Form)

Hi Jose / BluePeak procurement team,

Thanks for the time last week — excited to get BluePeak into Redwood's vendor portal so you can provision orders and start the pilot. Attaching our current MSA (Redwood_MSA_v2_redline.docx) and a prefilled order form template (BluePeak_OrderForm_Template.xlsx) with the fields we expect for EDI/PO routing. A few asks to move things forward:  

1) Can you confirm whether you prefer Ariba or Coupa for PO issuance? If Ariba, please share your portal enrollment ID and preferred contact for connector setup.
2) Please confirm remit-to and invoice email for AP and whether you require an EDI 810 (invoice) or a PDF invoice attachment only.
3) Legal redlines: our counsel flagged two items likely to be negotiated — indemnity sub-limit language and the liability cap tied to specific service tiers. If you can route the draft to your contracts team (contracts@bluepeakhealth.com) that would speed the loop.
4) Evidence: could you upload your SOC2 report or a summary? We need it for our procurement checklist.

Proposed next steps: once we have portal ID and preferred integration (Ariba/Coupa), Marcus (cc'd) will map PO fields and request a test PO. Mateo will take point on the MSA redlines.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2_redline.docx (redline), BluePeak_OrderForm_Template.xlsx

If you prefer, we can set a 30-min call tomorrow to walk fields and redlines.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
(415) 555-0189
From: Jose Silva <j.silva@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeakhealth.com, contracts@bluepeakhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment + initial redline (MSA + Order Form)

Stephanie — thanks, received. Quick answers below and a couple of additional requests.

1) Ariba — our finance team issues POs through Ariba (Supplier ID: 489217). I'll share portal admin access with your systems contact after legal confirms.
2) AP prefers EDI 810 for production invoices; during pilot we can accept PDF attachments. Remit-to: ap@bluepeakhealth.com
3) Contracts here will review the redline — forwarding now (see cc). Two initial asks from our side: a) can we carve out clinical data processing explicitly in Section 5 (data security) and b) the standard BluePeak insurance/indemnity addendum (we attached a profile).
4) SOC2: attached BluePeak_Company_Profile.pdf includes a SOC2 summary and our auditor contact.

We can do a field walkthrough Thursday 2/15 at 11am PT — Marcus, can you make that to cover EDI mapping?

—Jose
Jose Silva
Procurement Manager
BluePeak Health
j.silva@bluepeakhealth.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Feb 2028 12:46:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Portal enrollment + initial redline (MSA + Order Form)

Forwarding BluePeak's note — they prefer Ariba and provided a Supplier ID. I skimmed the redline and flagged these priority legal items:  

- Indemnity: their proposed addendum narrows our indemnity; we should propose a mutual indemnity with a carve for third-party clinical data processors.
- Liability cap: they want a 1x fees cap; we should keep tiered caps tied to committed throughput in Dedicated contracts.
- Data residency: BluePeak calls out clinical data; confirm whether the pilot will transmit PHI. If PHI is in scope, we need BAA terms and an S3 bucket region guarantee.

Action items for internal owners: 
- Stephanie: confirm whether pilot will include PHI (risk acceptance) and capture AP remit for contract exhibits.
- Marcus: prepare the EDI/field mapping checklist and a sample test PO that mirrors expected Ariba field usage.
- Kimberly: can you take a quick look at the insurance language we may need to supplement?

I'll set up a 30-min legal walkthrough after the field call.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Contracts
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jose Silva <j.silva@bluepeakhealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2028 10:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment + initial redline (MSA + Order Form) — EDI/PO field questions

Hi Jose — I can make Thursday's 11am PT slot and will share a short mapping doc before the call. A few clarifying questions up front so the walkthrough is efficient:  

1) Which Ariba PO fields do you populate at line-level vs. header-level? (we need: PO number, line number, SKU, commodity code, price, tax, ship-to, bill-to, delivery date)
2) Do you send PO splits for partial shipments and if so, how do you represent acceptance/acknowledgement?
3) Any custom invoice tolerances (quantity / price thresholds) we should know for automatic ACK/NACK?

I'll attach a sample test PO and proposed field crosswalk right after this message (will send as soon as I finish). If AP wants EDI 810 in production, our engineering team will request a test endpoint and we can iterate.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
GTM Systems Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Contracts Team <contracts@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: j.silva@bluepeakhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2028 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment + initial redline (MSA + Order Form)

Stephanie / Mateo — we reviewed the redline and proposed two edits:  

1) Section 5 (Data Security): we need a clause explicitly excluding protocols around clinical trial raw data from Redwood-managed backups unless a separate BAA is signed.
2) Insurance / Indemnity: we can accept a mutual indemnity but request the standard BluePeak schedule for insurance limits; see attached profile.

We will propose tracked changes inside your MSA and send back by EOD Friday. For onboarding, Ariba Supplier ID 489217 is confirmed — we'll provision a test PO to your staging endpoint once you provide the endpoint URL.

Thanks,
BluePeak Contracts
contracts@bluepeakhealth.com
